personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A PRD that someone already clicked through before it reaches me is the step I skip today; the bugs arrive with their steps.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: I only need to know a bug was found and fixed, or that I must decide; the room saying it in one row is enough.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: QA reporting and the Engineer fixing keeps one writer per branch, the rule I would set for my team.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A bug filed with steps on the preview and proven red before the fix is how I want it; QA never touching the branch is what I asked for.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: A QA job, up to five bug-fix jobs and a second QA job before the Reviewer starts fills my runners twice as long.

objection.text: Each PRD now costs a QA job, up to five bug-fix jobs and a second QA job before the Reviewer even starts, so my runners are full twice as long. I want the QA pair skipped when QA 1 passes and to know what it cost.
